description:
The wallet behind the code: ref (a public handle for support), balance_usd,
        cashback_percent, the deposit rules that apply to it now (min_usd, max_usd,
        first, bonus tiers), the last 50 transactions, orders (with their tokens — the
        wallet is where a buyer's order links are kept) and deposits. Needs the wallet
        code.
name: get_wallet
